definitions.gloss: bread flour; strong wheat flour; high-gluten flour
definitions.explanation: A type of wheat flour with high protein (gluten) content, producing a chewy, elastic texture. Used for bread, pizza dough, and noodles.

examples.japanese: ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強力粉|きょうりきこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need bread flour to bake bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強力粉|きょうりきこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦もちもち→もちもち：05260_mochimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Pizza dough becomes chewy when made with bread flour.

examples.japanese: {強力粉|きょうりきこ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{薄力粉|はくりきこ}→薄力粉：20705_hakurikiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{半々|はんはん}→半々：20666_hanhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ほどよい⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Mixing bread flour and cake flour in equal parts creates dough with a nicely balanced texture.

notes:
Composed of {強力|きょうりき} (strong/high strength) + {粉|こ} (flour/powder). The name refers to the high gluten content — '{強|きょう}' meaning strong and '{力|りき}' meaning strength.

USAGE:
Used in bread-making, pizza dough, and some types of noodles where a chewy, elastic texture is desired. Home baking of bread (⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧) has become a popular hobby in Japan, driving demand for {強力粉|きょうりきこ}.
The reading is きょうりきこ, not ごうりきこ. In Japanese supermarkets, {強力粉|きょうりきこ} is typically shelved alongside ⟦{薄力粉|はくりきこ}→薄力粉：20705_hakurikiko⟧ in the baking section.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強力粉|きょうりきこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to bake bread with bread flour
- {強力粉|きょうりきこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こねる: to knead bread flour
- {強力粉|きょうりきこ}300g: 300 grams of bread flour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薄力粉|はくりきこ}→薄力粉：20705_hakurikiko⟧: cake flour (low gluten) — for cakes, cookies, and tempura
- ⟦{中力粉|ちゅうりきこ}→中力粉：28725_chuurikiko⟧: medium flour — between the two, used for udon and some pastries
- ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧: wheat flour — the general term
